name: ヨハネ・パウロ2世像
enBlurb: In Nagasaki Prefecture, a statue commemorates Pope John Paul II's visit and his message of peace. This landmark serves as a poignant reminder of the region's unique Christian heritage and its efforts towards global harmony.

name: 松尾芭蕉句碑
enBlurb: Located in Aichi Prefecture, this monument pays tribute to Matsuo Basho, one of Japan's most revered haiku masters. It stands as a point of reflection for admirers of his poetry and a symbol of his enduring literary legacy.

name: 原子爆弾落下中心地碑
enBlurb: The Atomic Bomb Hypocenter Monument in Nagasaki Prefecture marks the exact point where the atomic bomb detonated. This solemn landmark encourages visitors to reflect on the devastating impact of war and the importance of global peace.

name: 清水寺
enBlurb: One of Kyoto Prefecture's most iconic sites, Kiyomizu-dera Temple is renowned for its magnificent wooden stage offering panoramic city views. This historic Buddhist temple draws countless visitors seeking both spiritual solace and breathtaking scenery.

name: 姫路城
enBlurb: Himeji Castle, situated in Hyogo Prefecture, is widely considered Japan's most beautiful surviving feudal castle. Its elegant white facade and expansive grounds offer a remarkable glimpse into traditional Japanese architecture and defensive design.

name: 東京国際空港
enBlurb: As a vital gateway to Japan, Tokyo International Airport, also known as Haneda Airport, efficiently connects travelers to and from Tokyo Metropolis. This bustling hub facilitates both international and domestic journeys, serving millions annually.

name: 東京スカイツリー
enBlurb: Soaring high above Tokyo Metropolis, the Tokyo Skytree is a prominent broadcasting and observation tower. Visitors ascend to its viewing decks for unparalleled, sweeping vistas of the sprawling city below.

name: 金閣寺
enBlurb: Kinkaku-ji Temple, a dazzling Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto Prefecture, is instantly recognizable for its top two floors completely covered in gold leaf. Reflected beautifully in the surrounding pond, this Golden Pavilion offers a magnificent sight to all who visit.

name: 硫黄島
enBlurb: Part of Tokyo Metropolis, Iwo Jima is an island of profound historical significance, particularly known for its pivotal role in World War II. While access is typically restricted, it remains a powerful symbol of remembrance and wartime history.

name: 対馬
enBlurb: Tsushima Island, located in Nagasaki Prefecture, is a captivating island known for its rich natural landscapes and strategic position between Japan and Korea. Visitors can explore its rugged coastlines, ancient forests, and distinct local culture.

name: 法隆寺
enBlurb: Horyu-ji Temple in Nara Prefecture is renowned for housing some of the world's oldest wooden structures, offering a profound glimpse into early Japanese Buddhist architecture. Visitors are drawn to its serene grounds and the spiritual heritage preserved within its ancient halls.

name: 城中焼亡埋骨墳
enBlurb: In Osaka Prefecture, the Castle Remains Burial Mound marks a historically significant site, hinting at the presence of an ancient fortress. It invites visitors to ponder the region's past defense strategies and the lives of those who once inhabited this area.

name: 青木ヶ原樹海
enBlurb: Aokigahara Forest, nestled at the base of Mount Fuji in Yamanashi Prefecture, is known for its dense trees and unique lava rock terrain. This tranquil yet mysterious woodland attracts those seeking a distinct natural experience amidst its ancient, quiet groves.

name: 知床国立公園
enBlurb: Shiretoko National Park, located on Hokkaido's northeastern tip, is a spectacular wilderness area celebrated for its dramatic coastal cliffs, pristine forests, and diverse wildlife. It's a prime destination for nature enthusiasts seeking breathtaking landscapes and outdoor exploration.

name: 大正天皇東宮殿下行啓記念地
enName: Emperor Taisho Crown Prince Visit Memorial Site
enBlurb: This memorial site in Aichi Prefecture commemorates a significant visit by Emperor Taisho when he was still the Crown Prince. It serves as a historical landmark, inviting visitors to reflect on imperial history and its connection to the local region.

name: 端島 (軍艦島)
enBlurb: Off the coast of Nagasaki Prefecture, Hashima Island, famously known as Battleship Island, is an evocative abandoned mining town. Its striking, desolate urban landscape draws visitors interested in industrial heritage and a unique glimpse into a bygone era.

name: 淡路島
enBlurb: Awaji Island, situated in Hyogo Prefecture, is a scenic destination known for its pleasant coastal views and mild climate. Visitors come to enjoy its relaxed atmosphere, explore its natural beauty, and experience tranquil island life.

name: アレフ大阪道場
enBlurb: The Aleph Osaka Dojo in Osaka Prefecture functions as a training and meeting facility. It caters to individuals interested in the specific practices and teachings associated with the Aleph organization.

name: お台場
enBlurb: Odaiba, a large artificial island in Tokyo Bay, offers a vibrant urban escape with expansive shopping centers, diverse entertainment options, and stunning waterfront views. It's a popular spot for both locals and tourists seeking modern Tokyo experiences and leisure.

name: 皇居
enBlurb: The Imperial Palace, located in the heart of Tokyo, serves as the primary residence of the Emperor of Japan, surrounded by moats and massive stone walls. Visitors can explore its beautiful East Garden and admire the historical architecture from outside the inner grounds.

name: 伊勢神宮 内宮
enBlurb: The Naiku (Inner Shrine) of Ise Grand Shrine in Mie Prefecture is one of Japan's most sacred Shinto sites, dedicated to the sun goddess Amaterasu Omikami. Pilgrims and visitors come to experience its profound spiritual atmosphere and admire the traditional architecture nestled within ancient forests.

name: 天智天皇陵
enBlurb: This solemn mausoleum in Kyoto Prefecture marks the final resting place of Emperor Tenji, a significant figure in early Japanese history. It offers a tranquil spot for reflection on imperial lineage and ancient times.

name: 石垣島
enBlurb: Ishigaki Island, part of Okinawa Prefecture, boasts stunning coral reefs, crystal-clear waters, and white sandy beaches. It's a paradise for snorkeling, diving, and enjoying the relaxed, tropical island lifestyle.

name: 高徳院
enBlurb: Kotoku-in Temple in Kanagawa Prefecture is famous for its monumental outdoor bronze statue of Amida Buddha, known as the Great Buddha of Kamakura. Visitors flock here to marvel at this iconic cultural treasure and experience its serene surroundings.

name: 与那国島
enBlurb: Yonaguni Island, located in Okinawa Prefecture, is Japan's westernmost island, renowned for its dramatic underwater rock formations and unique natural beauty. It attracts divers and adventurers seeking to explore its mysterious marine landscape and remote charm.

name: 種子島
enBlurb: Situated in Kagoshima Prefecture, Tanegashima Island is famous as the site where firearms were first introduced to Japan. Today, it's also known for its beautiful beaches and as a launch site for Japan's space program, blending history with modern innovation.

name: 東京ディズニーランド
enBlurb: Tokyo Disneyland, located in Chiba Prefecture, brings beloved Disney stories and characters to life through thrilling rides, enchanting parades, and captivating shows. It's a magical destination for families and fans of all ages seeking unforgettable entertainment.
imageCredit: 東京ディズニーランド

name: 名古屋城
enBlurb: Nagoya Castle in Aichi Prefecture is celebrated for its impressive reconstruction, including the opulent Honmaru Palace, showcasing exquisite traditional architecture and artistry. Visitors can explore its grounds and learn about feudal Japan.

name: 比叡山
enBlurb: Towering over Shiga Prefecture, Mt. Hiei is a significant spiritual center, home to the Enryaku-ji Temple complex, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Hikers and pilgrims ascend its trails to explore ancient temples and enjoy panoramic views.

name: 江戸城
enBlurb: Though largely replaced by the Imperial Palace, the grounds of Edo Castle in Tokyo still reveal remnants of its formidable past as the seat of the Tokugawa shogunate. Visitors can walk through its expansive East Garden and imagine the grandeur of feudal Japan.

name: 首里城
enBlurb: Shuri Castle, located in Okinawa Prefecture, was once the royal palace of the Ryukyu Kingdom, showcasing unique architectural styles distinct from mainland Japan. It offers a fascinating insight into the islands' rich cultural heritage and history.

name: 奄美大島
enBlurb: Amami Oshima Island in Kagoshima Prefecture is a lush, natural paradise boasting pristine beaches, dense mangrove forests, and vibrant coral reefs. It's an ideal destination for nature lovers and those seeking a tranquil escape with opportunities for watersports and exploration.

name: 熊本城
enBlurb: Kumamoto Castle in Kumamoto Prefecture is one of Japan's most impressive and historically significant fortresses, known for its robust stone walls and elegant main keep. Visitors come to admire its architectural resilience and explore its extensive grounds.

name: 松本城
enBlurb: Matsumoto Castle in Nagano Prefecture stands out as one of Japan's premier original castles, celebrated for its striking black exterior and elegant design. Visitors can step inside to explore its preserved interiors and enjoy views of the surrounding mountains.

name: 平等院
enBlurb: Byodo-in Temple in Kyoto Prefecture is a UNESCO World Heritage site, most famous for its stunning Phoenix Hall, which is depicted on the Japanese 10-yen coin. Visitors are drawn to its exquisite Heian-period architecture and tranquil garden setting.

name: 南鳥島
enBlurb: Minamitori Island, part of Tokyo, marks Japan's easternmost territory, offering a unique sense of remote isolation. While access is highly restricted, its geographical significance makes it a notable point of interest on maps and for those fascinated by extreme locations.

name: 崇徳天皇御廟
enBlurb: Located in Kyoto Prefecture, Emperor Sutoku's Imperial Mausoleum is a solemn site dedicated to a former Japanese emperor. Visitors come to reflect on imperial history and pay their respects in a tranquil setting.

name: 石見銀山遺跡
enBlurb: Explore the Iwami Ginzan Silver Mine Remains in Shimane Prefecture, a UNESCO World Heritage site offering a glimpse into Japan's historic mining industry. Visitors can walk among the preserved tunnels and structures, learning about the rich legacy of silver extraction.

name: 厳島
enBlurb: Itsukushima Island in Hiroshima Prefecture is renowned for its iconic "floating" torii gate, part of the Itsukushima Shrine. This picturesque island attracts visitors eager to witness the shrine's unique architecture and enjoy its serene coastal beauty.

name: 種子島宇宙センター
enBlurb: Discover the Tanegashima Space Center in Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan's largest rocket launch complex. Visitors can explore exhibits detailing the country's space exploration efforts and witness impressive rocket displays.

name: 西表島
enBlurb: Iriomote Island, nestled in Okinawa Prefecture, is a largely untamed sub-tropical paradise, famed for its dense mangroves and unique ecosystem. Adventurous travelers come to explore its pristine jungles, rivers, and diverse wildlife.

name: 飛くずれキャンプ場
enBlurb: Hikuzure Campground in Akita Prefecture offers a refreshing escape into nature, providing facilities for overnight stays under the stars. It's an ideal spot for outdoor enthusiasts looking to enjoy camping and the tranquil surroundings.

name: 松江城
enBlurb: Matsue Castle, located in Shimane Prefecture, stands as one of Japan's few remaining original castles. Visitors can ascend its historic keep to enjoy panoramic views of the city and Lake Shinji, immersing themselves in feudal-era architecture.

name: 銀閣寺
enBlurb: The Ginkaku-ji Temple, or Silver Pavilion, in Kyoto Prefecture, is celebrated for its exquisite Zen garden and elegant temple grounds. Visitors are drawn to its refined aesthetic and the tranquil atmosphere, reflecting a distinct period of Japanese culture.

name: 京都御所
enBlurb: Located in the heart of Kyoto Prefecture, the Kyoto Imperial Palace served as the residence of the Imperial Family for centuries. Visitors can explore the historic grounds and admire the traditional Japanese architecture that once housed emperors.

name: 富士箱根伊豆国立公園
enBlurb: Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park, spanning parts of Kanagawa Prefecture, is a diverse natural wonderland famous for its iconic views of Mount Fuji, volcanic landscapes, and hot springs. Visitors flock here to enjoy hiking, scenic lakes, and relaxing onsen experiences.
imageCredit: 富士箱根伊豆国立公園

name: 伊豆大島
enBlurb: Izu Oshima Island, part of Tokyo, is the largest of the Izu Islands, known for its active volcano, Mount Mihara, and dramatic landscapes. Travelers come to hike volcanic trails, enjoy coastal views, and experience the island's unique natural beauty.

name: 八丈島
enBlurb: Hachijo Island, an outlying island of Tokyo, offers a rugged volcanic landscape and clear ocean waters, making it a popular spot for diving and outdoor activities. Visitors can explore its lush trails and enjoy the serene island atmosphere away from the mainland's hustle.

name: 宮古島
enBlurb: Miyako Island in Okinawa Prefecture is celebrated for its stunning white sand beaches, vibrant coral reefs, and incredibly clear turquoise waters. It's a paradise for snorkelers, divers, and anyone seeking a relaxing tropical getaway.

name: 明治神宮
enBlurb: The Meiji Shrine, located in a vast forested area in Tokyo, is a grand Shinto shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken. Visitors can find a serene escape from the city's bustle, walking through its impressive torii gates and peaceful grounds.

name: 延暦寺
enBlurb: Perched atop Mount Hiei in Shiga Prefecture, Enryaku-ji Temple is a sprawling complex that serves as the head temple of the Tendai school of Buddhism. Visitors are drawn to its profound spiritual history and the tranquil mountain setting, offering panoramic views.

name: 龍安寺
enBlurb: Ryoan-ji Temple in Kyoto Prefecture is renowned worldwide for its iconic rock garden, a masterpiece of Zen landscape architecture. Visitors come to contemplate the minimalist beauty of the garden and experience a moment of profound tranquility.

name: パーフェクトリバティー教団広島中央教会
enName: Perfect Liberty Kyodan Hiroshima Central Church
enBlurb: The Perfect Liberty Kyodan Hiroshima Central Church in Hiroshima Prefecture serves as a significant spiritual center for its followers. Visitors interested in religious architecture or seeking a place of quiet reflection may find its presence notable.
imageCredit: パーフェクト リバティー教団

name: 創価学会
enBlurb: Soka Gakkai in Hokkaido represents a significant center for this global Buddhist lay organization in the region. It serves as a place for members to gather for spiritual activities and foster community.

name: 乃木希典居住宅の趾
enBlurb: The Site of Nogi Maresuke's Residence in Fukuoka Prefecture commemorates the home of a prominent general from Japan's Meiji era. History enthusiasts can visit to reflect on the life and times of this influential figure and the period he shaped.

name: 広島城
enBlurb: Hiroshima Castle, located in Hiroshima Prefecture, is a reconstruction of a historic fortress, offering visitors insight into the city's feudal past. Explore its impressive grounds and museum to learn about its significance and resilience.

name: 霞ヶ浦（西浦）
enBlurb: Lake Kasumigaura, situated in Ibaraki Prefecture, is Japan's second-largest lake, providing a vast expanse of water for various activities. Visitors can enjoy boating, fishing, and birdwatching along its extensive shoreline, embracing the tranquil lakeside environment.

name: 沖ノ島
enBlurb: Okinoshima Island, off the coast of Fukuoka Prefecture, is a sacred island renowned for its remarkably preserved archaeological sites and ancient rituals. This historically significant island offers a profound glimpse into Japan's early religious practices.

name: 四天王寺
enBlurb: Shitenno-ji Temple in Osaka Prefecture stands as one of Japan's oldest Buddhist temples, founded in the 6th century. Visitors can explore its traditional pagodas, gates, and halls, experiencing a deep connection to early Japanese Buddhism.

name: 出雲大社
enBlurb: Izumo Taisha Grand Shrine in Shimane Prefecture is one of Japan's most ancient and revered Shinto shrines, dedicated to the deity of marriage and good fortune. Pilgrims and visitors flock here to witness its distinctive architectural style and partake in its spiritual traditions.

name: 東寺
enBlurb: To-ji Temple in Kyoto Prefecture is a renowned Buddhist temple, famous for its magnificent five-story pagoda, which is one of the tallest wooden pagodas in Japan. Visitors come to admire its impressive architecture and explore the tranquil temple grounds, soaking in centuries of spiritual heritage.

name: 昭憲皇太后陵
enBlurb: Located in Kyoto Prefecture, Empress Shoken's Imperial Mausoleum serves as the solemn resting place for Empress Shoken, consort of Emperor Meiji. This site offers visitors a tranquil setting for reflection and a glimpse into Japan's imperial history, surrounded by respectful landscaping.

name: 大久野島
enBlurb: Okunoshima Island, situated in Hiroshima Prefecture, is a unique destination offering a blend of natural beauty and an unusual resident population. Travelers visit to explore its coastal paths and discover the island's distinctive charm, making for a memorable day trip.

name: 二条城
enBlurb: Nijo Castle in Kyoto Prefecture stands as a magnificent example of Edo-period castle architecture, once serving as the Kyoto residence for the Tokugawa shoguns. Visitors can explore its grand palace buildings, adorned with intricate artwork, and wander through its beautiful traditional gardens.

name: 薬師寺
enBlurb: Discover Yakushi-ji Temple in Nara Prefecture, an ancient and highly revered Buddhist temple with a history stretching back over a millennium. It attracts visitors keen to admire its distinctive twin pagodas and other venerable structures, which house important cultural treasures.

name: 与那国島海底地形
enBlurb: Off the coast of Yonaguni Island in Okinawa Prefecture lies a fascinating underwater topography, a unique geological formation that draws divers from around the world. This mysterious submerged site invites exploration, offering an extraordinary glimpse into the ocean's depths.

name: 安土城
enBlurb: Azuchi Castle, located in Shiga Prefecture, holds historical significance as the site of one of Japan's most important castles during the Sengoku period. Although largely in ruins today, visitors can explore the remnants of its grand scale and imagine its past glory, offering a tangible connection to feudal Japan.

name: 利尻島
enBlurb: Rishiri Island, off the coast of Hokkaido, is renowned for its iconic conical peak, Mount Rishiri, which dominates the island's landscape. This remote island destination offers breathtaking natural scenery, attracting hikers and nature lovers to its tranquil shores and trails.

name: 青ヶ島
enBlurb: Aogashima Island, a remote volcanic island administered by Tokyo Prefecture, captivates visitors with its extraordinary natural formation: a distinctive caldera within a larger caldera. This isolated paradise offers dramatic landscapes and a sense of true escape for adventurers.

name: 三宅島
enBlurb: Miyakejima Island, part of the Izu island chain in Tokyo Prefecture, is an active volcanic island known for its dynamic natural environment. Travelers visit to witness its unique ecosystem shaped by volcanic activity and explore its rugged, verdant landscapes.

name: 竹富島
enBlurb: Taketomi Island in Okinawa Prefecture is a charming destination celebrated for its beautifully preserved traditional Ryukyuan village, complete with red-tiled roofs and white sand paths. Visitors can experience a slower pace of life, enjoying the island's unique cultural heritage and pristine beaches.

name: 猪苗代湖
enBlurb: Lake Inawashiro, nestled in Fukushima Prefecture, is Japan's fourth-largest lake, renowned for its exceptionally clear waters often called "heavenly mirror lake." It's a popular spot for various water sports during warmer months and offers picturesque scenery year-round.

name: 諏訪湖
enBlurb: Lake Suwa, located in the heart of Nagano Prefecture, is a scenic freshwater lake offering tranquil views of the surrounding mountains. This significant body of water is a focal point for local culture and provides opportunities for lakeside strolls and enjoying the natural beauty.

name: 大雪山国立公園
enBlurb: Hokkaido's Daisetsuzan National Park, often called the "Roof of Hokkaido," is Japan's largest national park, encompassing a vast range of volcanic peaks and pristine wilderness. It's a paradise for hikers, offering stunning alpine landscapes, diverse flora, and opportunities to experience untouched nature.

name: 東京ジャーミイ・トルコ文化センター
enBlurb: The Tokyo Camii & Turkish Culture Center in Tokyo Prefecture is a stunning architectural marvel, serving as Japan's largest mosque and a vibrant hub for Turkish culture. Visitors are welcome to admire its intricate Ottoman-style design and learn about Turkish traditions and hospitality.

name: 上賀茂神社
enBlurb: Kamigamo Shrine, one of Kyoto Prefecture's oldest and most important Shinto shrines, boasts a history dating back over a millennium. Visitors are drawn to its serene grounds, traditional architecture, and the sense of ancient spiritual reverence that permeates this sacred site.

name: 平安神宮
enBlurb: Heian Shrine in Kyoto Prefecture is celebrated for its vibrant vermilion architecture and expansive traditional gardens, offering a striking contrast to the city's modern pulse. The shrine commemorates the imperial family and provides a picturesque setting for visitors to experience a grand example of Japanese shrine design.

name: 富岡製糸場
enBlurb: The Tomioka Silk Mill in Gunma Prefecture stands as a significant testament to Japan's rapid industrialization during the Meiji era. This historic site, once a model factory, offers visitors a unique glimpse into the country's past as a leading silk producer and its journey towards modernization.

name: 彦根城
enBlurb: Hikone Castle, located in Shiga Prefecture, is one of Japan's few castles to retain its original keep and many of its inner structures from the Edo period. Visitors can explore its authentic fortifications, impressive main tower, and scenic gardens, offering a genuine step back in time.

name: 犬山城
enBlurb: Perched atop a hill overlooking the Kiso River in Aichi Prefecture, Inuyama Castle is a treasured national treasure and one of Japan's oldest surviving original castles. Visitors can ascend to its historic keep for panoramic views of the surrounding landscape and immerse themselves in centuries of samurai history.

name: 新燃岳
enBlurb: Mt. Shinmoedake, a prominent volcano in Miyazaki Prefecture, offers a dramatic natural landscape within the Kirishima mountain range. While known for its volcanic activity, it also provides rugged hiking trails and stunning vistas for those seeking adventure in its unique environment.

name: 西之島
enBlurb: Nishinoshima Island, a remote and dynamic volcanic island under Tokyo Prefecture's administration, is a remarkable example of ongoing geological formation. This fascinating island continues to grow through volcanic activity, offering a rare glimpse into the powerful forces shaping our planet.

name: 壱岐島
enBlurb: Iki Island, situated in Nagasaki Prefecture, is a captivating island destination celebrated for its stunning coastlines, ancient historical sites, and rich marine life. Visitors can enjoy pristine beaches, explore archaeological wonders, and savor the island's unique blend of nature and heritage.

name: 父島
enBlurb: Chichijima Island, the largest of the remote Ogasawara Islands administered by Tokyo Prefecture, is a subtropical paradise renowned for its pristine natural environment and unique endemic species. This World Heritage site offers incredible opportunities for whale watching, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters, and exploring lush landscapes.

name: 東京カテドラル聖マリア大聖堂
enBlurb: Tokyo Cathedral St. Mary in Tokyo Prefecture is an architectural masterpiece, recognized for its striking modernist design crafted from stainless steel. This prominent Catholic cathedral serves as a significant spiritual center and attracts visitors keen to admire its unique, soaring interior and exterior.

name: 天橋立神社
enBlurb: This shrine in Kyoto Prefecture is an integral part of the scenic Amanohashidate sandbar, one of Japan's three most beautiful views. Visitors come here to enjoy the spiritual atmosphere and the breathtaking natural landscape.

name: 五稜郭
enBlurb: Discover Goryokaku in Hokkaido, Japan's first Western-style star-shaped fort. Its distinctive design makes it a popular spot for both history enthusiasts and those seeking picturesque views, especially during the cherry blossom season.

name: 伏見城
enBlurb: Explore Fushimi Castle in Kyoto Prefecture, a significant historical landmark reflecting Japan's feudal past. Visitors can appreciate its grand scale and architectural style, which evoke the power and prestige of its original era.

name: 屈斜路湖
enBlurb: Hokkaido's Lake Kussharo is a vast caldera lake offering stunning natural scenery. Its shores feature natural hot springs, inviting visitors to relax or enjoy various water-based activities amidst the serene landscape.

name: 洞爺湖
enBlurb: Situated in Hokkaido, Lake Toya is a beautiful caldera lake renowned for its clear waters and surrounding volcanic landscapes. Many visitors come to enjoy its hot springs, boat tours, and the nightly firework displays during warmer months.

name: さいたまスーパーアリーナ
enBlurb: The Saitama Super Arena in Saitama Prefecture is a premier entertainment venue. It regularly hosts a wide array of international and domestic concerts, major sporting events, and large-scale exhibitions, drawing crowds for diverse spectacles.
imageCredit: さいたまスーパーアリーナ

name: 吉原
enBlurb: Yoshiwara, located in Tokyo, holds a significant place in the city's historical narrative as a former pleasure district. Today, visitors can explore the area to reflect on its past and experience the contemporary atmosphere of this unique Tokyo neighborhood.

name: 小豆島
enBlurb: Shodoshima Island, part of Kagawa Prefecture in the Seto Inland Sea, is celebrated for its Mediterranean-like climate and olive groves. Travelers flock here to enjoy its picturesque coastal scenery, unique art installations, and local culinary delights.

name: 仁和寺
enBlurb: Discover Ninna-ji Temple in Kyoto Prefecture, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its serene gardens and magnificent architecture. It is especially popular in spring for its unique, low-growing Omurozakura cherry trees.

name: 日光東照宮
enBlurb: Nikko Toshogu Shrine in Tochigi Prefecture is an incredibly ornate and lavishly decorated Shinto shrine. This UNESCO World Heritage site draws visitors with its intricate carvings, vibrant colors, and profound historical significance.

name: 岐阜城
enBlurb: Perched atop Mount Kinka in Gifu Prefecture, Gifu Castle offers commanding panoramic views of the city and the Nagara River. This reconstructed castle invites visitors to delve into local history and enjoy its strategic mountain setting.

name: 大雪山
enBlurb: Hokkaido is home to Mt. Daisetsuzan, a majestic volcanic mountain range often called the "Roof of Hokkaido." It's a prime destination for hikers and nature lovers, offering stunning alpine landscapes and some of Japan's earliest autumn colors.

name: 爆心地碑
enBlurb: In Nagasaki Prefecture, the Atomic Bomb Hypocenter Park stands as a solemn memorial marking the exact point where the atomic bomb detonated. Visitors come here to reflect on the events of the past and contemplate the importance of peace.

name: 北硫黄島
enBlurb: Kita-Iwojima Island, a remote part of Tokyo's Ogasawara chain, is an uninhabited volcanic island known for its raw, untouched natural beauty. Its isolated location offers a unique glimpse into pristine oceanic ecosystems and geological formations.

name: 儀志布島
enBlurb: Gishibu Island, located in Okinawa Prefecture, is a small, idyllic island renowned for its crystal-clear waters and vibrant coral reefs. It's a perfect destination for snorkeling, diving, and enjoying the peaceful, unspoiled beauty of Okinawa's marine environment.

name: 礼文島
enBlurb: Off the northern coast of Hokkaido lies Rebun Island, often called the "Island of Flowers" for its unique alpine flora that blooms at sea level. Hikers and nature enthusiasts visit to explore its dramatic coastal trails and enjoy the breathtaking natural beauty.

name: 御蔵島
enBlurb: Mikurajima Island, an island in Tokyo's Izu chain, is a haven for nature lovers and marine enthusiasts. It is particularly famous for its wild dolphin population, offering visitors the unique opportunity to swim alongside these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat.

name: 田沢湖オートキャンプ場縄文の森たざわこ
enBlurb: Located in Akita Prefecture, Tazawako Jomon no Mori Campground provides a wonderful opportunity to connect with nature. Campers can enjoy the serene forest setting and explore the area, which likely holds connections to Japan's ancient Jomon period.

name: 阿蘇くじゅう国立公園
enBlurb: Aso Kuju National Park, spanning parts of Oita Prefecture, is a dramatic landscape centered around one of the world's largest active calderas, Mount Aso. Visitors come to hike through expansive grasslands, witness volcanic activity, and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views.
imageCredit: 阿蘇くじゅう国立公園

name: モビリティリゾートもてぎ
enBlurb: In Tochigi Prefecture, Mobility Resort Motegi is a comprehensive facility dedicated to motorsports and family entertainment. It features a world-class racetrack hosting various events, alongside attractions designed for visitors of all ages to experience the joy of mobility.
imageCredit: モビリティリゾートもてぎ

name: 点字ブロック発祥の地
enBlurb: Visit the Birthplace of Tactile Paving Blocks in Okayama Prefecture, a unique landmark celebrating a significant Japanese innovation for accessibility. This site serves as a quiet testament to thoughtful urban design and its global impact.
imageCredit: 視覚障害者誘導用ブロック

name: 軍艦長門の碑
enBlurb: The Battleship Nagato Monument in Kanagawa Prefecture stands as a tribute to a pivotal vessel in Japanese naval history. It offers a poignant spot for visitors to reflect on the past and the significant role of the battleship Nagato.

name: 岡山城
enBlurb: Okayama Castle, famously nicknamed "Crow Castle" for its distinctive black exterior, is a prominent historical site in Okayama Prefecture. Visitors can explore its impressive architecture and learn about its past, often combining a visit with the nearby Korakuen Garden.

name: 奥尻島
enBlurb: Okushiri Island, situated off the coast of Hokkaido, captivates visitors with its rugged coastline and unique rock formations. It's a popular destination for enjoying fresh seafood and experiencing the tranquil, unspoiled beauty of a remote Japanese island.

name: 田代島
enBlurb: Tashirojima Island in Miyagi Prefecture is famously known as "Cat Island," a unique destination where felines significantly outnumber human residents. Cat lovers flock here to interact with the island's many friendly stray cats and enjoy its charming, laid-back atmosphere.

name: 鳥島
enBlurb: This remote island, part of Tokyo's Izu archipelago, offers a unique natural escape. Visitors come to witness its rugged volcanic landscapes and observe diverse seabird populations.

name: 八坂神社
enBlurb: Located in Kyoto Prefecture, Yasaka Shrine is a revered Shinto sanctuary known for its vibrant red gates and traditional architecture. It serves as a spiritual heart for locals and a captivating cultural site for visitors.

name: 西湖
enBlurb: Nestled in Yamanashi Prefecture, Lake Saiko is one of the Fuji Five Lakes, offering serene waters and picturesque views of the surrounding forests. It's a popular destination for camping, fishing, and boating amidst tranquil natural beauty.

name: 東福寺
enBlurb: Tofuku-ji Temple, a significant Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto Prefecture, is renowned for its expansive grounds and stunning traditional gardens. Visitors are drawn to its impressive main gate and the vibrant autumn foliage that blankets the valley.

name: 男体山
enBlurb: Dominating the landscape of Tochigi Prefecture, Mt. Nantai is a sacred peak offering challenging hiking trails to its summit. From the top, adventurers are rewarded with panoramic vistas of Lake Chuzenji and the surrounding national park.

name: 支笏湖
enBlurb: Hokkaido's Lake Shikotsu is a caldera lake celebrated for its exceptionally clear, deep blue waters, making it one of Japan's most pristine. The area invites visitors to enjoy scenic drives, boat tours, and lakeside relaxation amidst breathtaking natural scenery.

name: サロマ湖
enBlurb: As the largest lake in Hokkaido, Lake Saroma is a brackish lagoon connected to the Sea of Okhotsk. It's a fantastic spot for enjoying expansive water views, birdwatching, and experiencing the unique ecosystem where freshwater meets saltwater.

name: 小田原城天守閣
enBlurb: The impressive main keep of Odawara Castle in Kanagawa Prefecture stands as a prominent historical landmark. Visitors can explore its reconstructed interiors to learn about samurai history and enjoy commanding views from its highest floors.

name: 口永良部島
enBlurb: Kuchinoerabujima Island, located in Kagoshima Prefecture, is an active volcanic island offering a rugged and untamed natural experience. It attracts those seeking a remote escape and a chance to observe dynamic geological formations.

name: 徳之島
enBlurb: Part of Kagoshima Prefecture's Amami Islands, Tokunoshima Island is known for its beautiful white sand beaches, clear turquoise waters, and unique local culture. It's an ideal destination for snorkeling, diving, and experiencing a laid-back island lifestyle.

name: 新島
enBlurb: Niijima Island, one of Tokyo's Izu Islands, is a popular destination renowned for its distinctive white sand beaches and excellent surfing conditions. Visitors can also admire the island's unique koga stone architecture and local glass art.

name: 母島
enBlurb: The remote Hahajima Island, part of Tokyo's Ogasawara Islands, offers pristine natural beauty and a tranquil escape. Its clear waters are perfect for snorkeling and diving, revealing rich marine life and untouched coral reefs.

name: 下鴨神社
enBlurb: One of Kyoto Prefecture's oldest and most significant Shinto shrines, Shimogamo Shrine is nestled within a sacred primeval forest alongside the Kamo River. Visitors come to experience its serene atmosphere and admire its traditional architecture.

name: 南禅寺
enBlurb: Nanzen-ji Temple, a prominent Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto Prefecture, boasts expansive grounds and several sub-temples with beautiful gardens. Its unique brick aqueduct, an unexpected historical feature, offers a striking contrast to the traditional temple architecture.

name: 西芳寺
enBlurb: Famous for its breathtaking moss garden, Saiho-ji Temple in Kyoto Prefecture offers a uniquely tranquil and verdant spiritual experience. This UNESCO World Heritage site invites contemplation amidst its meticulously cultivated natural beauty.

name: 原爆の子の像
enBlurb: Located in Hiroshima Prefecture, the Children's Peace Monument stands as a poignant symbol of peace and hope. It honors the young victims of the atomic bombing and inspires visitors to reflect on the importance of a peaceful future.

name: 丸岡城
enBlurb: Maruoka Castle in Fukui Prefecture is one of Japan's few remaining original castles, offering a rare glimpse into feudal architecture. Its sturdy keep provides historical insight and scenic views of the surrounding townscape.

name: 宗谷岬
enBlurb: Marking the northernmost point of Hokkaido and Japan, Cape Soya offers expansive, windswept views of the ocean. Visitors come to witness this geographical milestone and contemplate the vastness of the northern seas.

name: 牧島
enBlurb: Makishima Island, situated off the coast of Kumamoto Prefecture, provides a tranquil setting for those seeking a peaceful island getaway. Its scenic coastline and calm waters offer a refreshing escape from urban life.

name: 大浦天主堂
enBlurb: As Japan's oldest existing church, Oura Cathedral in Nagasaki Prefecture is a significant historical and architectural landmark. This beautiful European-style basilica tells the story of early Christianity in Japan and its hidden followers.

name: 浦上天主堂
enBlurb: Urakami Cathedral, located in Nagasaki Prefecture, stands as a powerful symbol of resilience and faith. Once the largest church in Asia, its reconstructed grandeur continues to inspire visitors and commemorate its profound history.

name: 弘前城
enBlurb: In Aomori Prefecture, Hirosaki Castle is a beloved historical site, especially famous for its magnificent cherry blossom displays in spring. The castle's original three-story keep and surrounding park offer a picturesque setting for visitors.

name: 金沢城
enBlurb: Kanazawa Castle, nestled in Ishikawa Prefecture, invites visitors to explore its beautifully reconstructed grounds and impressive historical buildings. The expansive park provides a serene environment to stroll and appreciate the grandeur of a former feudal domain.

name: 三十三間堂
enBlurb: Sanjusangen-do Temple in Kyoto Prefecture is renowned for its incredibly long main hall housing a thousand life-sized statues of Kannon, the goddess of mercy. This awe-inspiring collection creates a powerful and unique spiritual experience for all who visit.

name: 京都タワー
enBlurb: Standing tall above Kyoto Station, Kyoto Tower offers a modern contrast to the city's ancient temples and shrines. Visitors ascend to its observation deck for panoramic views of Kyoto Prefecture and the surrounding mountains.

name: 平城宮跡
enBlurb: Explore the expansive Heijo Palace Site in Nara Prefecture, the former imperial capital of Japan. Visitors can wander through the reconstructed palace grounds and learn about its historical importance.

name: 鳥取砂丘
enBlurb: Discover the impressive Tottori Sand Dunes, a unique natural wonder stretching along the coast of Tottori Prefecture. These vast dunes offer breathtaking views of the Sea of Japan and a distinct desert-like landscape.

name: 日本キリスト教団 茨木春日丘教会
enBlurb: The Ibaraki Kasugaoka Church in Osaka Prefecture offers a serene space for reflection and admiration of its unique architectural design. This distinctive church is a quiet landmark for visitors seeking spiritual tranquility.

name: 西表石垣国立公園
enBlurb: Immerse yourself in the tropical beauty of Iriomote Ishigaki National Park, located in Okinawa Prefecture. This park preserves stunning islands, rich coral reefs, and diverse ecosystems, perfect for nature enthusiasts.

name: 東京ディズニーシー
enBlurb: Experience a world of fantasy and adventure at Tokyo DisneySea in Chiba Prefecture. This unique theme park offers elaborate themed ports, captivating shows, and thrilling attractions for visitors of all ages.

name: 篠穂の滝
enBlurb: Shinoho Falls, nestled in Kagoshima Prefecture, provides a picturesque natural escape. Visitors can enjoy the serene beauty of the cascading water and the refreshing atmosphere of its surroundings.

name: 巣鴨プリズン跡
enBlurb: Explore the historic Sugamo Prison Remains in Tokyo, offering a poignant glimpse into a significant site from Japan's past. This landmark invites visitors to reflect on its historical role and legacy.

name: 軍艦山城の碑
enBlurb: The Battleship Yamashiro Monument in Kanagawa Prefecture stands as a tribute to naval history. It commemorates the legacy of the battleship Yamashiro, offering a place for reflection on its significance.

name: やすらぎの園
enBlurb: Discover Yasuragi no Sono, or "Garden of Tranquility," a peaceful retreat located in Aichi Prefecture. This serene spot offers beautifully maintained grounds perfect for a quiet stroll and moments of calm reflection.

name: 高知城
enBlurb: Kochi Castle in Kochi Prefecture stands as one of Japan's original castles, largely preserved in its Edo-period form. Visitors can explore its impressive architecture and enjoy commanding views of the surrounding city.

name: 北大東島
enBlurb: Venture to Kita Daito Island in Okinawa Prefecture, a remote and captivating island offering pristine natural beauty. It's an ideal destination for those seeking unique island landscapes and a tranquil escape.

name: 波照間島
enBlurb: Hateruma Island, part of Okinawa Prefecture, is renowned for its stunning turquoise waters and white sand beaches. This idyllic island offers a perfect setting for relaxation and enjoying the pristine marine environment.

name: 鶴岡八幡宮
enBlurb: Visit Tsurugaoka Hachimangu Shrine in Kanagawa Prefecture, a prominent Shinto shrine with deep historical roots. Its grand approach and serene grounds offer a significant cultural experience and a peaceful escape.

name: 夫婦岩
enBlurb: Marvel at Meoto Iwa, the "Married Couple Rocks," a famous natural landmark off the coast of Mie Prefecture. These two sacred rocks, bound by a shimenawa rope, are particularly stunning at sunrise.

name: 奥多摩湖
enBlurb: Escape the city bustle at Lake Okutama, a tranquil reservoir nestled in the western mountains of Tokyo. This scenic lake offers opportunities for boating, fishing, and enjoying the surrounding lush natural landscape.

name: 大徳寺
enBlurb: Explore the extensive Daitoku-ji Temple complex in Kyoto Prefecture, a significant center of Rinzai Zen Buddhism. Its numerous sub-temples feature exquisite Zen gardens and traditional architecture, offering a profound sense of tranquility.

name: 高山寺
enBlurb: Kozan-ji Temple, nestled in the hills of Kyoto Prefecture, is a historic Buddhist temple known for its serene natural setting. Visitors can appreciate its ancient architecture and the peaceful atmosphere of its grounds.

name: 知恩院
enBlurb: Discover Chion-in Temple in Kyoto Prefecture, the head temple of the Jodo Shu sect, renowned for its immense scale. Its massive Sanmon Gate and grand halls create a truly impressive and spiritual experience.

name: 天龍寺
enBlurb: Tenryu-ji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site in Kyoto Prefecture, is celebrated for its exquisite Zen garden. This prominent temple offers a harmonious blend of historical architecture and natural beauty.

name: 錦帯橋
enBlurb: Admire the iconic Kintai Bridge in Yamaguchi Prefecture, a magnificent five-arched wooden bridge spanning the Nishiki River. Its distinctive design and scenic surroundings make it a captivating landmark.

name: 善光寺
enBlurb: Zenko-ji Temple in Nagano Prefecture is one of Japan's most important and popular pilgrimage sites. This ancient Buddhist temple attracts visitors seeking spiritual solace and a glimpse into its rich history.

name: 宇治上神社
enBlurb: Visit Ujigami Shrine in Kyoto Prefecture, recognized as one of Japan's oldest extant Shinto shrine buildings. This tranquil site offers a glimpse into ancient Japanese architecture and spiritual tradition.

name: 川崎重工 C-1
enBlurb: Aviation enthusiasts can observe the Kawasaki C-1 Transport Aircraft, a landmark in Tottori Prefecture. This impressive aircraft offers a tangible connection to Japan's aerospace history and engineering.

name: 開聞岳
enBlurb: Embark on a hike up Mt. Kaimon in Kagoshima Prefecture, a striking conical volcano often called "Satsuma Fuji." The ascent offers rewarding panoramic views of the coastline and surrounding landscapes.

name: 鳴門の渦潮
enBlurb: Witness the incredible Naruto Whirlpools, a spectacular natural phenomenon occurring in the strait between Tokushima Prefecture and Awaji Island. Powerful tidal currents create these mesmerizing and colossal whirlpools.

name: 今帰仁城跡
enBlurb: Explore the historic Nakijin Castle Remains in Okinawa Prefecture, a UNESCO World Heritage site that offers a glimpse into the Ryukyu Kingdom's past. Visitors can wander through the ancient stone walls and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding landscape and coastline.

name: 岡崎城
enBlurb: Discover Okazaki Castle in Aichi Prefecture, a historically significant landmark known as the birthplace of Tokugawa Ieyasu. The reconstructed keep and grounds invite visitors to explore Japan's samurai heritage and enjoy the scenic surroundings.

name: 松山城
enBlurb: Perched atop a hill in Ehime Prefecture, Matsuyama Castle is one of Japan's twelve original castles, offering a rare look at feudal architecture. Its well-preserved structures and expansive grounds provide stunning views over the city and Seto Inland Sea.

name: 南大東島
enBlurb: Venture to Minami Daito Island, a remote and unique landmass in Okinawa Prefecture formed from uplifted coral reefs. This distinctive island offers visitors a chance to experience untouched nature and a tranquil escape from the bustling mainland.

name: 座間味島
enBlurb: Zamami Island, part of Okinawa Prefecture's Kerama Islands, is renowned for its crystal-clear turquoise waters and pristine white-sand beaches. It's a popular destination for snorkeling, diving, and simply relaxing amidst breathtaking natural beauty.

name: 神津島
enBlurb: Part of the Izu Islands in Tokyo Prefecture, Kozushima Island is a volcanic island known for its dramatic landscapes and clear ocean. Visitors can enjoy hiking trails that lead to scenic viewpoints and explore the island's unique geological features.

name: 悪石島
enBlurb: Experience the remote charm of Akuseki Island, one of the Tokara Islands in Kagoshima Prefecture. This secluded island offers a unique cultural experience and a chance to witness traditional island life amidst rugged natural beauty.

name: 久米島
enBlurb: Kume Island, located in Okinawa Prefecture, is celebrated for its beautiful beaches, coral reefs, and tranquil atmosphere. It's an ideal destination for those seeking a peaceful island getaway with opportunities for swimming, diving, and enjoying pristine coastal scenery.

name: 鶴ヶ城
enBlurb: Visit Tsuruga Castle in Fukushima Prefecture, a prominent symbol of the Aizu region's samurai history. The impressive white walls and red-tiled roof stand majestically, inviting visitors to delve into its storied past and enjoy the surrounding park.

name: 北野天満宮
enBlurb: Kitano Tenmangu Shrine in Kyoto Prefecture is dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane, the deity of scholarship, making it a popular spot for students. The shrine grounds are particularly stunning during plum blossom season, drawing many visitors to admire the vibrant flowers.

name: 三井寺（園城寺）
enBlurb: Discover Mii-dera Temple, also known as Onjo-ji Temple, a significant Buddhist complex in Shiga Prefecture with a history spanning over a millennium. Its extensive grounds house numerous national treasures and offer a serene atmosphere for contemplation.

name: 唐招提寺
enBlurb: Toshodai-ji Temple in Nara Prefecture is a UNESCO World Heritage site founded by the Chinese monk Ganjin in the 8th century. Visitors come to admire its classical Nara period architecture and the profound spiritual ambiance within its ancient halls.

name: 伊吹山
enBlurb: Ascend Mt. Ibuki in Shiga Prefecture, a popular destination for hikers seeking rewarding panoramic views from its summit. The mountain offers various trails suitable for different skill levels, leading through diverse alpine flora.

name: 浜名湖
enBlurb: Lake Hamana, located in Shizuoka Prefecture, is a large brackish lake known for its beautiful scenery and diverse marine life. Visitors can enjoy a variety of water sports, boat cruises, and cycling along its picturesque shores.

name: 中尊寺
enBlurb: Chuson-ji Temple in Iwate Prefecture is a UNESCO World Heritage site, celebrated for its exquisite Konjiki-do (Golden Hall) and its role in preserving Heian-era Buddhist culture. The temple complex offers a tranquil setting for visitors to appreciate ancient artistry and spiritual heritage.

name: 雲仙天草国立公園
enBlurb: Explore Unzen Amakusa National Park, spanning parts of Nagasaki Prefecture, renowned for its volcanic landscapes, therapeutic hot springs, and stunning island scenery. The park offers a unique blend of mountain and coastal beauty, inviting visitors to hike, relax, and discover diverse ecosystems.

name: 金剛山
enBlurb: Hike Mt. Kongo, situated on the border of Nara Prefecture, a beloved destination for nature enthusiasts throughout the year. Its well-maintained trails lead to a summit offering refreshing views and a chance to experience the changing seasons.

name: 沖永良部島
enBlurb: Discover Okinoerabu Island in Kagoshima Prefecture, a subtropical paradise known for its intricate limestone caves, lush greenery, and pristine beaches. The island provides a peaceful retreat and opportunities for exploring unique geological formations.

name: 南硫黄島
enBlurb: Minami Iwo Jima Island is a remote, uninhabited volcanic island within Tokyo Prefecture, part of the Ogasawara Islands. It stands as a stark, natural landmark, primarily observed from a distance due to its protected and inaccessible status.

name: 黒島
enBlurb: Visit Kuroshima Island in Okinawa Prefecture, a small, tranquil island known for its rich marine life and as a haven for cattle. It offers a peaceful escape where visitors can enjoy quiet beaches and observe traditional island life.

name: さっぽろテレビ塔
enBlurb: The Sapporo TV Tower stands as an iconic landmark in Hokkaido's capital, offering visitors a prime vantage point over the city. From its observation deck, one can enjoy sweeping views of Odori Park and the urban landscape.

name: 新郷村キリストの墓
enName: Tomb of Christ in Shingo Village
enBlurb: Explore the intriguing Tomb of Christ in Shingo Village, Aomori Prefecture, a site associated with a unique local legend. This unusual landmark draws visitors curious about its fascinating, albeit controversial, historical claims.

name: 若草山
enBlurb: Overlooking Nara City in Nara Prefecture, Mt. Wakakusa is a gentle mountain offering pleasant hiking trails and stunning views of the ancient capital. It is also famous for its annual Yamayaki (mountain burning) festival, which lights up the night sky.

name: 輪王寺
enBlurb: Rinno-ji Temple in Tochigi Prefecture is a significant Buddhist temple and a UNESCO World Heritage site, forming part of the Nikko shrines and temples complex. Visitors can explore its grand halls and admire the impressive statues within a serene mountain setting.

name: 二荒山神社
enBlurb: Futarasan Shrine, nestled in Tochigi Prefecture, is one of Nikko's most ancient and revered Shinto shrines, dedicated to the deities of Mount Nantai, Mount Nyohō, and Mount Tarō. Its peaceful grounds and traditional architecture offer a spiritual retreat amidst nature.

name: 桂離宮
enBlurb: Katsura Imperial Villa in Kyoto Prefecture is a masterpiece of traditional Japanese architecture and landscape design. Visitors can admire its exquisitely crafted buildings and meticulously arranged gardens, renowned for their serene beauty and historical significance.

name: 史跡 元興寺小塔院跡
enName: Former Gangoji Temple Small Pagoda Site
enBlurb: The Former Gangoji Temple Small Pagoda Site in Nara Prefecture marks a significant historical spot, hinting at the grandeur of an ancient Buddhist complex. It offers a quiet place for visitors to reflect on the area's rich religious heritage and imagine its past structures.

name: 六甲山
enBlurb: Ascend Mt. Rokko in Hyogo Prefecture for invigorating hikes and breathtaking panoramic views of Kobe city and Osaka Bay. Its various trails cater to different skill levels, making it a popular destination for nature lovers and photographers alike.

name: 風の電話
enBlurb: The Wind Phone in Iwate Prefecture is a deeply moving landmark, offering a unique space for remembrance and emotional connection. Visitors come to "speak" to loved ones who have passed away, finding solace in this poignant, symbolic gesture.

name: 汐留シオサイト
enBlurb: Shiodome Siosite in Tokyo is a contemporary urban hub featuring sleek skyscrapers, diverse dining options, and shopping opportunities. It's a prime destination for experiencing modern Japanese city life and enjoying impressive architectural views.

name: 油すましどんの墓
enBlurb: This distinctive site in Kumamoto Prefecture is believed to be the resting place of Aburasumashi-don, a character from local folklore. It offers a unique cultural curiosity for those interested in Japanese legends and mythical creatures.

name: 清洲城
enBlurb: Kiyosu Castle in Aichi Prefecture stands as a reconstructed testament to Japan's feudal past, inviting visitors to explore its grounds and learn about its historical importance. It offers insights into samurai culture and regional power struggles.

name: 小倉城
enBlurb: Explore Kokura Castle in Fukuoka Prefecture, a prominent historical landmark offering a look into the region's samurai era. Visitors can enjoy its impressive architecture and the surrounding gardens, which provide a peaceful respite.

name: 沖大東島
enBlurb: Oki Daito Island, part of Okinawa Prefecture, is a remote and tranquil island offering a unique escape. Its isolated location provides opportunities for experiencing untouched natural beauty and pristine marine environments.

name: 式根島
enBlurb: Discover Shikinejima Island, an idyllic part of Tokyo Prefecture, known for its natural hot springs and beautiful, calm beaches. It's a perfect destination for relaxation and enjoying marine activities in a serene setting.

name: 利島
enBlurb: Toshima Island, a small and verdant island in Tokyo Prefecture, is celebrated for its camellia flowers and peaceful atmosphere. Visitors come to enjoy its natural beauty and quiet charm, far from the city's hustle.

name: 住吉大社
enBlurb: Sumiyoshi Taisha Shrine in Osaka Prefecture is one of Japan's oldest and most important Shinto shrines, renowned for its distinctive architectural style. Visitors come to admire its unique structures and experience a deep sense of spiritual history.

name: 妙心寺
enBlurb: Myoshin-ji Temple in Kyoto Prefecture is a vast complex of Zen Buddhist temples, offering a serene environment for contemplation and exploration. Its many sub-temples showcase diverse garden designs and traditional architecture.

name: 西本願寺
enBlurb: Nishi Hongan-ji Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage site in Kyoto Prefecture, is a magnificent example of Jodo Shinshu Buddhist architecture. Visitors can marvel at its grand halls and intricate decorations, reflecting centuries of religious artistry.

name: 萩城
enBlurb: The ruins of Hagi Castle in Yamaguchi Prefecture stand as a historical reminder of the region's feudal past, nestled within the scenic city of Hagi. Visitors can explore the castle grounds and imagine its former glory.

name: 恵庭岳
enBlurb: Mt. Eniwa in Hokkaido offers challenging hiking trails and rewarding views of Lake Shikotsu and the surrounding wilderness. It's a popular spot for outdoor enthusiasts seeking a memorable ascent.

name: 石清水八幡宮
enBlurb: Perched atop Mt. Otokoyama in Kyoto Prefecture, Iwashimizu Hachimangu Shrine is a historically significant Shinto sanctuary. Visitors ascend to admire its grand structures and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding landscape.

name: 幟町カトリック教会
enBlurb: Noboricho Catholic Church in Hiroshima Prefecture offers a place of worship and reflection, distinguished by its unique architectural style. It provides a peaceful sanctuary within the city, inviting contemplation.

name: 永平寺
enBlurb: Eihei-ji Temple in Fukui Prefecture is a renowned head temple of the Soto Zen school, enveloped by ancient cedar forests. It offers a profound experience of Zen practice and a glimpse into monastic life.

name: ヤン・ヨーステン記念像
enBlurb: This statue in Tokyo commemorates Jan Joosten, a Dutch navigator who played a significant role in early Japanese-European relations. It serves as a historical marker, acknowledging a unique chapter in Japan's international connections.

name: 座喜味城
enBlurb: Zakimi Castle in Okinawa Prefecture is a UNESCO World Heritage site, known for its distinctive curvilinear stone walls and historical significance. Visitors can explore the well-preserved ruins and enjoy views of the surrounding area.

name: 中城城跡
enBlurb: The Nakagusuku Castle Ruins in Okinawa Prefecture offer a fascinating glimpse into the Ryukyuan Kingdom's past, with impressive stone walls overlooking the Pacific Ocean. It's a historically rich site providing scenic vistas.

name: 与論島
enBlurb: Yoron Island, part of Kagoshima Prefecture, is a tropical paradise known for its crystal-clear turquoise waters and white sandy beaches. It's an ideal destination for snorkeling, diving, and relaxing in a picturesque setting.

name: 中之島
enBlurb: Nakanoshima Island in Kagoshima Prefecture offers a tranquil escape, characterized by its natural beauty and serene atmosphere. Visitors can experience a slower pace of life and enjoy the island's unique charm.

name: 小浜島
enBlurb: Kohama Island, nestled in Okinawa Prefecture, is a small, charming island known for its sugar cane fields and relaxed atmosphere. It's a perfect spot for cycling and experiencing the laid-back island life.

name: 鳩間島
enBlurb: Discover the serene charm of Hatoma Island, a small gem nestled within Okinawa Prefecture. Visitors come here to enjoy its pristine beaches, clear turquoise waters, and a peaceful, slow-paced island life.

name: 伊江島
enBlurb: Ie Island offers a delightful escape off the coast of Okinawa, known for its iconic conical peak and expansive fields. It's a popular destination for cycling, exploring scenic coastal areas, and experiencing a relaxed island ambiance.

name: 称名滝
enBlurb: Witness the magnificent power of Shomyo Falls, cascading dramatically within Toyama Prefecture. This impressive waterfall draws visitors to admire its sheer drop and the lush, rugged landscape that frames its powerful descent.

name: 黒部ダム
enBlurb: Explore Kurobe Dam in Toyama Prefecture, a monumental feat of engineering set amidst stunning alpine scenery. Visitors can walk along the dam's crest, marvel at its immense scale, and enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and the reservoir.

name: 松前城
enBlurb: Step back in time at Matsumae Castle, Hokkaido's only traditional Japanese castle. This historic landmark offers insight into the region's past, attracting visitors to admire its reconstructed keep and picturesque grounds.

name: 赤石岳
enBlurb: Ascend Mt. Akaishi, a prominent peak in Shizuoka Prefecture, renowned among hikers for its challenging trails and rewarding vistas. Part of the Southern Japanese Alps, it offers a true wilderness experience with expansive views of the surrounding ranges.

name: 金峯山寺
enBlurb: Discover Kinpusen-ji Temple, a significant spiritual site nestled in the mountains of Nara Prefecture. This ancient temple serves as a central hub for Shugendo mountain asceticism and impresses visitors with its grand main hall and serene atmosphere.

name: 法起寺
enBlurb: Visit Hokki-ji Temple in Nara Prefecture, home to one of Japan's oldest surviving three-story pagodas. This tranquil temple offers a glimpse into early Buddhist architecture and a peaceful retreat amidst rural landscapes.

name: 神田川
enBlurb: Experience the serene charm of Lake Kandagawa, an urban waterway winding through Tokyo. This peaceful lake offers pleasant walking paths along its banks, providing a refreshing escape and picturesque scenery, especially during cherry blossom season.

name: 横浜中華街
enBlurb: Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Yokohama Chinatown, Japan's largest Chinatown located in Kanagawa Prefecture. This bustling district is a sensory delight, offering a vast array of authentic Chinese cuisine, colorful shops, and lively cultural experiences.

name: 福岡タワー
enBlurb: Ascend Fukuoka Tower, a striking modern landmark offering unparalleled panoramic views of Fukuoka City and Hakata Bay. From its observation decks, visitors can enjoy expansive vistas, especially beautiful at sunset and night.

name: 勝連城跡
enBlurb: Explore the historic Katsuren Castle Ruins, a UNESCO World Heritage site perched on a hill in Okinawa Prefecture. These ancient stone walls provide a fascinating look into the Ryukyuan Kingdom's past and offer breathtaking views of the surrounding coastline.

name: 諏訪之瀬島
enBlurb: Venture to Suwanosejima Island, a remote volcanic island in Kagoshima Prefecture known for its active volcano. This rugged island offers a unique natural experience for those seeking untouched landscapes and a glimpse into geological forces.

name: 渡名喜島
enBlurb: Discover Tonaki Island, a tranquil and less-visited island gem within Okinawa Prefecture. It offers pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters perfect for snorkeling, and a serene atmosphere away from the crowds.

name: 阿嘉島
enBlurb: Experience the breathtaking beauty of Aka Island, one of the stunning Kerama Islands in Okinawa Prefecture. This paradise is celebrated for its vibrant coral reefs, abundant marine life, and sparkling white sand beaches, making it ideal for diving and snorkeling.

name: 外離島
enBlurb: For an ultimate escape, consider Sotobanari Island, a truly remote and uninhabited isle in Okinawa Prefecture. This secluded spot offers pristine natural beauty for those seeking untouched landscapes and profound solitude.

name: ニコライ堂
enBlurb: Marvel at the distinctive architecture of Nikolai-do Cathedral, officially the Holy Resurrection Cathedral, a prominent Russian Orthodox church in Tokyo. This historic landmark stands out with its grand Byzantine-style dome and serves as a significant spiritual and cultural site.

name: 幸福の科学
enBlurb: Observe the headquarters of Happy Science in Kanagawa Prefecture, a modern religious organization. While primarily a place of worship and study for its followers, its distinctive buildings may draw architectural interest.

name: 鹿島神宮
enBlurb: Discover the ancient Kashima Jingu Shrine in Ibaraki Prefecture, one of Japan's oldest and most revered Shinto shrines. Set amidst a sprawling, sacred forest, visitors come to experience its profound spiritual atmosphere and admire its impressive traditional architecture.

name: 氷川神社
enBlurb: Visit Hikawa Shrine, a significant spiritual center located in Saitama Prefecture. This revered shrine offers a tranquil escape with its expansive grounds, traditional buildings, and a long history deeply rooted in the region.

name: 浅草神社
enBlurb: Explore Asakusa Shrine, a historic Shinto shrine adjacent to the famous Senso-ji Temple in Tokyo. This venerable shrine hosts vibrant festivals and offers visitors a glimpse into traditional Japanese religious practices and architecture.

name: 総持寺
enBlurb: Discover Soji-ji Temple in Kanagawa Prefecture, one of the two head temples of the Soto Zen school of Buddhism. Its expansive grounds and various halls invite visitors to experience the profound tranquility of Zen and admire traditional temple architecture.

name: 御岳山
enBlurb: Escape the city bustle at Mt. Mitake, a popular hiking destination within Tokyo's western mountains. This accessible mountain offers scenic trails, a historic shrine at its summit, and refreshing natural beauty for a day trip.

name: 仙台城
enBlurb: Visit the historic Sendai Castle Ruins, also known as Aoba Castle, perched on a hill overlooking Sendai City in Miyagi Prefecture. While only remnants of the original structure remain, the site offers panoramic views and a tangible connection to the powerful Date clan.

name: 鞍馬山
enBlurb: Embark on a journey up Mt. Kurama, a sacred mountain just north of Kyoto City in Kyoto Prefecture. This spiritual destination is renowned for its ancient Kurama-dera temple, mystical atmosphere, and scenic hiking trails that wind through dense forests.

name: 高台寺
enBlurb: Kodai-ji Temple in Kyoto Prefecture offers visitors a chance to explore a significant Zen Buddhist temple. Its beautifully maintained gardens and historic buildings provide a serene escape and a glimpse into traditional Japanese aesthetics.

name: ブルーインパルス
enBlurb: Blue Impulse, the aerobatic display team of the Japan Air Self-Defense Force, is associated with Miyagi Prefecture. Enthusiasts and general visitors alike might seek out opportunities to witness their breathtaking aerial displays, showcasing precision and skill in the skies.

name: 岩村城
enBlurb: Perched high in Gifu Prefecture, Iwamura Castle offers visitors a journey back in time to one of Japan's most formidable mountain castles. Though largely in ruins today, its strategic location provides expansive views of the surrounding landscape and a sense of its historical significance.

name: 函館山
enBlurb: Mt. Hakodate in Hokkaido is renowned for its spectacular panoramic views, especially at night, making it a popular destination for sightseers. Visitors can enjoy a leisurely hike up its trails or take a convenient ropeway to the summit to admire the unique topography of Hakodate city and its surroundings.

name: 祈りの杜
enBlurb: In Hyogo Prefecture, the tranquil Inori no Mori, or Forest of Prayer, invites visitors seeking a peaceful natural retreat. This serene woodland offers a contemplative atmosphere, perfect for quiet reflection amidst lush greenery.

name: 恵那山
enBlurb: Towering majestically in Nagano Prefecture, Mt. Ena presents a rewarding challenge for hikers and nature lovers. Its trails wind through diverse ecosystems, leading to a summit that offers expansive vistas of the Central Japan Alps and surrounding region.

name: 弥山
enBlurb: Mt. Misen, located in Hiroshima Prefecture, is the highest peak on Miyajima Island and a significant spiritual site. Hikers can ascend its well-maintained trails to discover ancient temples and enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the Seto Inland Sea.

name: 熊野速玉大社
enBlurb: One of the revered Kumano Sanzan shrines, Kumano Hayatama Taisha in Wakayama Prefecture offers a profound spiritual experience. This historic shrine, nestled by the sea, is a key destination on the ancient Kumano Kodo pilgrimage routes, drawing visitors to its sacred grounds and vibrant architecture.

name: 網走湖
enBlurb: Lake Abashiri, nestled in the vast landscapes of Hokkaido, provides a picturesque setting for outdoor activities and relaxation. Depending on the season, visitors can enjoy boating, fishing, or observing local wildlife along its shores, with stunning views reflecting the changing seasons.

name: 小牧山
enBlurb: Mt. Komaki in Aichi Prefecture offers a pleasant and accessible hiking experience with a rich historical backdrop. Visitors can enjoy a relatively gentle ascent to the summit, where they are rewarded with views of the surrounding city and plains.

name: 生駒山
enBlurb: Rising prominently between Nara and Osaka Prefectures, Mt. Ikoma is a popular destination for hikers and sightseers alike. Its slopes feature various trails, leading to scenic viewpoints that offer expansive vistas of the Kansai region.

name: 伊良部島
enBlurb: Irabu Island, part of Okinawa Prefecture, captivates visitors with its pristine white-sand beaches and crystal-clear turquoise waters. This idyllic island is a perfect spot for swimming, snorkeling, and simply unwinding amidst a tropical paradise.

name: 天売島
enBlurb: Off the coast of Hokkaido lies Teuri Island, a haven particularly renowned for its spectacular seabird colonies. Nature enthusiasts flock here to observe diverse bird species nesting on its dramatic cliffs and to enjoy the island's raw, natural beauty.

name: 池間島
enBlurb: Connected by a scenic bridge within Okinawa Prefecture, Ikema Island is a tranquil escape known for its stunning coral reefs and azure waters. It's an ideal destination for diving and snorkeling, allowing visitors to explore a vibrant underwater world.

name: 大島
enBlurb: Oshima Island, situated in Hokkaido, offers a rugged and remote natural experience for those seeking untouched landscapes. Visitors can explore its dramatic coastline and enjoy the wild, untamed beauty characteristic of Japan's northernmost prefecture.

name: 熊野本宮大社
enBlurb: Nestled deep within the mountains of Wakayama Prefecture, Kumano Hongu Taisha is a revered head shrine of the Kumano Kodo pilgrimage network. Visitors are drawn to its impressive torii gate and serene setting, experiencing a profound connection to ancient Japanese spirituality.

name: 太宰府天満宮
enBlurb: Dazaifu Tenmangu Shrine in Fukuoka Prefecture is a significant cultural landmark, dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane, the deity of scholarship. Students and visitors alike come to pray for academic success and to admire the shrine's beautiful grounds, including its plum blossom gardens.

name: 久保田城跡
enBlurb: The Kubota Castle Ruins in Akita Prefecture provide a window into the region's feudal past. Though the main castle structures are gone, the expansive grounds now serve as a park where visitors can stroll, appreciate the historical significance, and enjoy the tranquil atmosphere.

name: 秋田城跡
enBlurb: Exploring the Akita Castle Ruins in Akita Prefecture offers a glimpse into an important historical site from ancient Japan. The preserved foundations and surrounding park invite visitors to imagine the former grandeur of this administrative and defensive stronghold, now a peaceful urban green space.

name: 北海道神宮
enBlurb: Hokkaido Jingu Shrine, located in Sapporo, Hokkaido, is a prominent spiritual landmark offering a serene escape within the city. Visitors come to pay respects, experience traditional Japanese worship, and enjoy the peaceful, expansive grounds, especially beautiful during cherry blossom season.

name: 三内丸山遺跡
enBlurb: The Sannai-Maruyama Site in Aomori Prefecture is an extraordinary archaeological park showcasing a large Jomon period settlement. Visitors can explore reconstructed dwellings and learn about the daily life and culture of Japan's ancient inhabitants through fascinating exhibits.

name: 羽黒山 (山形県)
enBlurb: Mt. Haguro, one of the three sacred Dewa Sanzan mountains in Yamagata Prefecture, is a revered site for spiritual pilgrimage and natural beauty. Visitors can ascend ancient stone steps lined with towering cedar trees, leading to a historic pagoda and a profound sense of tranquility.

name: 相国寺
enBlurb: Shokoku-ji Temple, a significant Zen Buddhist temple in Kyoto Prefecture, offers a peaceful retreat from the city's bustle. Visitors can admire its grand architecture, explore its serene grounds, and appreciate its historical importance within Japanese Buddhism.

name: 富士急ハイランド
enBlurb: Situated in Yamanashi Prefecture, Fuji-Q Highland is a popular amusement park famous for its thrilling roller coasters and attractions. Adrenaline seekers flock here to experience world-class rides, often with spectacular views of nearby Mount Fuji.

name: 愛宕山
enBlurb: Mt. Atago, a prominent peak in Kyoto Prefecture, offers a challenging yet rewarding hike for nature enthusiasts. Ascending its trails leads to a significant shrine at the summit, providing both spiritual reflection and expansive views over the Kyoto basin.

name: 方廣寺
enBlurb: Explore Hoko-ji Temple, a historic landmark nestled in Kyoto Prefecture. Visitors come to admire its traditional architecture and soak in the tranquil ambiance of this spiritual site.

name: 桧原湖
enBlurb: Discover Lake Hibara, a picturesque body of water situated in Fukushima Prefecture. It's a popular destination for enjoying scenic views, boating, and various waterside activities amidst a tranquil setting.

name: 萬福寺
enBlurb: Manpuku-ji Temple, located in Kyoto Prefecture, offers visitors a glimpse into Japan's rich spiritual heritage. This landmark is celebrated for its distinctive architectural style and serene grounds, inviting contemplation and exploration.

name: 駒ヶ岳
enBlurb: Ascend Mt. Komagatake in Nagano Prefecture, a prominent mountain known for its rewarding hiking trails. From its slopes, adventurers can enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding natural landscape.

name: 小諸城
enBlurb: Komoro Castle, located in Nagano Prefecture, invites visitors to step back in time. Explore the historic ruins and grounds of this former castle, which offers insights into feudal Japan and scenic views.

name: 武田神社
enBlurb: Visit Takeda Shrine in Yamanashi Prefecture, a significant spiritual site. This landmark draws visitors seeking a connection to local history and a peaceful atmosphere within its sacred precincts.

name: 中海
enBlurb: Lake Nakaumi, an expansive brackish lake in Shimane Prefecture, is a distinctive natural feature of the region. Visitors can enjoy its vast waterscapes and the unique ecosystem that thrives along its shores.

name: 明石城
enBlurb: The impressive Akashi Castle stands in Hyogo Prefecture, offering a glimpse into Japan's samurai past. Its remaining structures and expansive grounds provide a historical backdrop for a pleasant stroll and exploration.

name: やんばる国立公園
enBlurb: Immerse yourself in the lush biodiversity of Yanbaru National Park, nestled in Okinawa Prefecture. This protected area is a haven for unique flora and fauna, inviting visitors to explore its pristine forests and natural beauty.

name: 高天原山
enBlurb: For a refreshing outdoor experience, head to Mt. Takamagahara in Gunma Prefecture. This mountain offers various hiking routes, allowing adventurers to enjoy tranquil natural surroundings and inspiring views.

name: 大奥跡
enBlurb: Explore the Ooku Site in Tokyo, an important historical landmark that offers insights into the Edo period. This area once played a significant role in the lives of the Shogun's court, inviting visitors to imagine its past grandeur.

name: 雲鷹丸
enBlurb: The Unyo Maru, a notable landmark in Tokyo, represents a piece of Japan's maritime heritage. Visitors can learn about its historical significance and admire this unique vessel.

name: 氷川丸
enBlurb: Step aboard the Hikawa Maru, a grand ocean liner permanently docked in Kanagawa Prefecture. This historic vessel is a fascinating landmark, offering visitors a glimpse into early 20th-century luxury travel and maritime history.

name: 忍城御三階櫓
enBlurb: Discover the Oshi Castle Gosankai Yagura in Saitama Prefecture, a distinctive turret that is part of the historic Oshi Castle complex. This landmark provides an excellent example of traditional castle architecture and offers views of the surrounding area.

name: 吉野ヶ里遺跡
enBlurb: Journey back in time at Yoshinogari Historical Park in Saga Prefecture, a sprawling archaeological site. This park meticulously reconstructs an ancient village, allowing visitors to experience life from Japan's Yayoi period.

name: 宇和島城
enBlurb: Uwajima Castle, an original castle tower remaining in Ehime Prefecture, offers a rare look at feudal architecture. Visitors can explore its well-preserved grounds and enjoy commanding views from its historic keep.

name: 赤穂城
enBlurb: Explore the extensive ruins of Ako Castle in Hyogo Prefecture, a significant historical landmark. The remaining stone walls and moats invite visitors to imagine its past grandeur and strategic importance.

name: 丸亀城
enBlurb: Marugame Castle, majestically situated in Kagawa Prefecture, is renowned for its impressive stone walls and original castle tower. Visitors come to admire its formidable architecture and enjoy panoramic views from its elevated position.

name: 原城跡
enBlurb: The Hara Castle Ruins in Nagasaki Prefecture mark a site of profound historical importance. Visitors can explore the remnants of this former stronghold, reflecting on its past and the events that unfolded here.

name: 平戸城
enBlurb: Hirado Castle, beautifully situated in Nagasaki Prefecture, offers a striking presence overlooking the sea. Visitors can explore its reconstructed keep and grounds, enjoying both its architectural beauty and scenic coastal views.

name: 慶留間島
enBlurb: Discover the serene beauty of Geruma Island, one of Okinawa Prefecture's charming islets. This tranquil destination is perfect for visitors seeking pristine beaches, clear turquoise waters, and a peaceful escape.

name: 口之島
enBlurb: Kuchinoerabu-jima Island, located in Kagoshima Prefecture, offers a rugged and authentic island experience. Visitors can explore its natural landscapes and enjoy the unique charm of this remote destination.

name: 下地島
enBlurb: Explore Shimoji Island, a captivating part of Okinawa Prefecture known for its stunning natural beauty. This island attracts visitors with its crystal-clear waters, vibrant marine life, and picturesque coastal scenery.

name: 来間島
enBlurb: Kurima Island, a small gem in Okinawa Prefecture, is celebrated for its pristine beaches and relaxed atmosphere. It's an ideal spot for visitors to unwind, enjoy the ocean breeze, and take in scenic island vistas.

name: 豊島
enBlurb: Teshima Island, nestled in Kagawa Prefecture, offers a unique blend of natural beauty and tranquil island life. Visitors are drawn to its serene landscapes and the distinctive atmosphere that permeates this charming destination.

name: 神田明神
enBlurb: Kanda Myojin Shrine, nestled in Tokyo, offers a glimpse into traditional Shinto practices and stunning architectural detail. Many visitors come here to pray for prosperity and good fortune, making it a lively spiritual hub.

name: 根津神社
enBlurb: Discover Nezu Shrine in Tokyo, celebrated for its picturesque tunnel of vermilion torii gates and serene atmosphere. It's a popular spot for its vibrant azalea gardens, especially stunning when in bloom.

name: 日枝神社
enBlurb: Hie Shrine, located in the heart of Tokyo, serves as a significant spiritual center for the city. Visitors often come to admire its grand architecture and experience a sense of tranquility amidst the urban bustle.

name: 増上寺
enBlurb: Explore Zojo-ji Temple, a prominent Buddhist temple in Tokyo with a rich history. Its expansive grounds offer a peaceful retreat and a striking contrast against the modern cityscape.

name: 建長寺
enBlurb: Kencho-ji Temple, situated in Kanagawa Prefecture, stands as one of Kamakura's most important Zen Buddhist temples. Visitors can wander through its historic halls and serene gardens, experiencing a deep sense of peace.

name: 円覚寺
enBlurb: Visit Engaku-ji Temple, a significant Rinzai Zen temple also found in Kanagawa Prefecture's historic Kamakura. This expansive complex invites contemplation with its traditional architecture and tranquil forested setting.

name: 飛鳥寺
enBlurb: Asuka-dera Temple in Nara Prefecture holds the distinction of being one of Japan's most ancient Buddhist temples. Travelers seeking a connection to early Japanese Buddhism and its foundational sites will find it a compelling destination.

name: 吉田神社
enBlurb: Discover Yoshida Shrine, a historic Shinto sanctuary nestled in Kyoto Prefecture. This shrine is revered for its unique architectural style and offers a quiet spiritual experience for those exploring the city.

name: 瑞巌寺
enBlurb: Journey to Zuigan-ji Temple in Miyagi Prefecture, a revered Zen Buddhist temple with a long and storied past. Its impressive main hall and surrounding caves attract visitors interested in its profound cultural heritage.

name: 建仁寺
enBlurb: Kyoto Prefecture's Kennin-ji Temple stands as the city's oldest Zen Buddhist temple, offering a profound sense of history and spiritual tranquility. Visitors can admire its exquisite garden designs and significant cultural artifacts.

name: 東本願寺
enBlurb: Marvel at Higashi Hongan-ji Temple, an immense Buddhist temple located in Kyoto Prefecture. Its grand scale and impressive architecture make it a powerful symbol of Jodo Shinshu Buddhism in Japan.

name: 泉涌寺
enBlurb: Sennyu-ji Temple in Kyoto Prefecture is a serene Buddhist complex historically associated with the Imperial family. Visitors can explore its beautiful grounds and experience a tranquil atmosphere away from the city's bustle.

name: 小川原湖
enBlurb: Lake Ogawara, situated in Aomori Prefecture, is a vast freshwater lake offering a variety of recreational activities. Its expansive waters are popular for fishing, boating, and enjoying the peaceful lakeside scenery.

name: 函館ハリストス正教会
enBlurb: The Hakodate Russian Orthodox Church in Hokkaido stands as a beautiful example of Russian Byzantine architecture. Visitors come to admire its distinctive onion domes and learn about its historical role in the region's international connections.

name: 西大寺
